name: omelette-fleet
description: A pane that draws the fleet (the orchestrator, its sub-agents and the units) and who is calling whom, and the delivery of the guard (it refuses what the guard refuses and pins a guarded role's model) and of the handoff block

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the fleet pane when a session starts, on a wide terminal; off leaves the /omelette-fleet command and the status line

animate.title: Animate running agents
animate.description: A spinner on a running agent or unit and a faster tick while anything runs; on the desktop, moving live lines and a pulsing frame. Off draws the same pane without motion

handoffGate.title: Refuse a compaction without a fresh handoff
handoffGate.description: On: a manual or automatic compaction is refused once when the newest open ledger has no handoff block of the last 30 minutes (a dated heading counts for its day); the next attempt within 10 minutes passes. Off: nothing is refused
